description: Safe Mix Concrete Limited is a ready-mix concrete producer that describes itself as the pioneer of Pakistan's ready-mix concrete industry and the only listed ready-mix concrete company in the country. It belongs to the Arif Habib group, has operated since 2005, and supplies ready-mix concrete from a plant at Global Industry, North Nazimabad, Karachi, with a fleet of 22 transit mixers and an office in Lahore.
headOffice: Plot # 1, Global Industry, Nusrat Bhutto Colony, Opposite Jamia Usmania, North Nazimabad, Karachi, Pakistan
